title: Workspace → Project → Dataset hierarchy across barkpark (routing, API, auth, UI)
description: Introduce a Workspace → Project → Dataset hierarchy across the whole barkpark app. Workspaces hold many Projects; Projects hold many Datasets; Datasets group existing content. Wave 1: Workspace + Project (container + routing + API + auth threading). Wave 2: Dataset. Spans api (Phoenix/LiveView), web frontend, js/packages client SDK, Go TUI, docs. Discovery via ~30-agent swarm; build phase-by-phase.
design:
ARCHITECTURE DECISIONS (locked 2026-05-25):
1. ISOLATION: Hard tenant boundary. Workspace = security perimeter. Token binds to workspace; every content query scoped by workspace_id; per-workspace membership/roles. Pre-existing holes to fix as part of Wave 1: (a) cross-dataset read leak (authed?=token-present), (b) no write-gate on /v1/data/mutate, (c) dormant token.dataset, (d) unauth /papers/:slug, (e) preview-JWT dataset claim, (f) rate-limiter dataset scope.
2. DATASET = collection of Documents. documents.dataset_id FK. The existing 'dataset' string column IS the migration seam (string -> string+id -> id-authoritative).
3. ROUTING: path-based /w/:workspace_slug/p/:project_slug/... uniformly across Phoenix routes, web frontend, and SDK.
4. MIGRATION: auto-backfill. Seed one Default Workspace -> one Default Project -> one Dataset per distinct existing dataset string; backfill all rows; zero data loss.
SCOPING LEVELS: documents/revisions/mutation_events/media_files/search_intel_*/search_synonyms -> dataset_id. schema_definitions -> project_id (OPEN: vs dataset_id; current unique (name,dataset) may need row-merge on backfill). webhooks -> project_id. api_tokens -> workspace_id. STAYS GLOBAL: codelists registry, api_token uniqueness, idempotency_keys, preview_token_jti, oban_jobs, webhook_deliveries.
WAVES: W1 = Workspace+Project (tables, routing, API, auth enforcement, migration). W2 = Dataset (FK flip from string).
SURFACES: api (Phoenix/LiveView), web frontend, js+packages/client SDK, Go TUI, docs.
